units.source_text: 且说头中将近来怨恨源氏公子，

en.t: Now, the Captain had recently come to resent Prince Genji,

units.source_text: 为的是源氏公子过于假扮正经，常常责备他的轻薄行为，

en.t: because Genji acted far too prim and proper and was always reproaching him for his frivolous conduct,

units.source_text: 而自己却满不在乎地东偷西摸，有了不少情妇。

en.t: while he himself, quite unconcerned, was carrying on here and there and had no small number of lovers.

units.source_text: 他常常想找他的破绽，以便报复。

en.t: He was always looking for some weakness of Genji's so that he could get back at him.

units.source_text: 这一天正好头中将也来会晤这内侍，

en.t: On this day, as it happened, the Captain also came to meet this Naishi,

units.source_text: 看见源氏公子先走了进去，心中非常高兴。

en.t: and when he saw Prince Genji go in ahead of him, he was delighted.

units.source_text: 他想乘此机会稍稍恐吓他一下，给他吃点苦头，

en.t: He thought he would take this chance to frighten Genji a little and make him suffer a bit,
and then ask him, "Have you repented from now on?"

units.source_text: 他暂不作声，站在门外静听动静。

en.t: For the moment he kept silent, standing outside the door and quietly listening for what was happening.
